cards.name: Random Rotation 3D
cards.summary: Expression-control pseudo effect: a panel of sliders (travel time, min/max X, Y and Z rotation, random start toggles) meant to drive a random 3D tumble of a layer. It draws nothing itself, and no preset shipped with AE 2026 wires expressions to it.
use_for: slow random 3D drift of floating photo cards or icons in an explainer
tumbling newspaper cut-outs or debris behind a trailer title
idle motion on a 3D logo plate between beats
avoid: adding it alone does nothing: the layer only moves once expressions read these sliders
the layer must be a 3D layer or X/Y rotation has no effect
large Y spins on footage expose the flat back of the layer and look cheap

params.name: Travel Time
params.does: seconds per random move from one target angle to the next

params.name: Travel Time Variation
params.does: random +/- seconds added to each travel time

params.name: Min Y Rotation
params.does: lowest random Y angle (degrees)

params.name: Max Y Rotation
params.does: highest random Y angle (degrees)

params.name: Min X Rotation
params.does: lowest random X angle (degrees)

params.name: Max X Rotation
params.does: highest random X angle (degrees)

params.name: Max Z Rotation
params.does: highest random Z (roll) angle (degrees)

params.name: Random Start Value
params.does: checkbox (0/1): start each layer at a different random angle

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml with no driving preset in AE 2026, so a script that wants the behaviour must enable 3D on the layer, add this effect, then write expressions on transform.xRotation / yRotation / zRotation, e.g. for Y: e=effect('Random Rotation 3D'); T=e('Travel Time'); s=Math.floor(time/T); seedRandom(s,true); a=random(e('Min Y Rotation'),e('Max Y Rotation')); seedRandom(s+1,true); b=random(e('Min Y Rotation'),e('Max Y Rotation')); ease(time%T,0,T,a,b). That sketch ignores Travel Time Variation and the Random Start checkboxes. Checkboxes are 0/1 numbers. Simpler alternative: wiggle(0.5,15) on Y Rotation. Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.

cards.name: Random Scale
cards.summary: Expression-control pseudo effect holding settings for random scale changes (travel time, min/max scale, lock X and Y, random start toggles). It draws nothing itself, and no preset shipped with AE 2026 wires expressions to it.
use_for: subtle random 'breathing' scale on icons or map pins in an explainer infographic
random size flicker on particles or bokeh shapes behind a title
irregular pulse on a 'BREAKING' badge so several copies do not move in sync
avoid: adding it alone does nothing: the layer only scales once an expression reads these sliders
default Min Scale 25 to Max Scale 100 is far too wide for footage; keep the range narrow (95-110)
scaling a full-frame clip below 100% exposes black edges

params.name: Travel Time
params.does: seconds per random move to the next scale target

params.name: Travel Time Variation
params.does: random +/- seconds added to each travel time

params.name: Min Scale
params.does: lowest random scale (%)

params.name: Max Scale
params.does: highest random scale (%)

params.name: Lock X And Y
params.does: checkbox (0/1): same random value for X and Y (uniform scale)

params.name: Random Start Value
params.does: checkbox (0/1): each layer starts at a different random scale

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect from PresetEffects.xml; no driving preset in AE 2026. A script must add it and write a Scale expression itself, e.g. e=effect('Random Scale'); T=e('Travel Time'); s=Math.floor(time/T); seedRandom(s,true); a=random(e('Min Scale'),e('Max Scale')); seedRandom(s+1,true); b=random(e('Min Scale'),e('Max Scale')); v=ease(time%T,0,T,a,b); [v,v] (use [v,v,v] on a 3D layer). That sketch ignores Lock X And Y = 0 (non-uniform), Travel Time Variation and the Random Start checkboxes. Checkboxes are 0/1 numbers. Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.

cards.name: Rotate Over Time
cards.summary: Control for the Behaviors preset 'Rotate Over Time': the preset adds this slider plus a Transform effect whose Rotation expression adds (time - inPoint) x the rate, so the layer spins continuously at a set speed. On its own the control does nothing.
use_for: slow-spinning sunburst or radial-ray background behind a title or quote card
rotating emblem, seal or badge in a political explainer graphic
spinning loader, vinyl record or gear icon in an AI-education explainer
slowly rotating globe or compass graphic in a news package
avoid: on a full-frame clip the rotation happens inside the layer bounds, so corners clip and transparent wedges appear
fast spins on detailed graphics strobe without motion blur
applying the bare effect by match name gives a slider with no motion

params.name: Rotation (degrees/second)
params.does: spin speed in degrees per second; negative values spin counter-clockwise

cards.equivalent: Premiere: keyframe Motion > Rotation linearly (no auto-spin effect)
cards.scripting: Apply with layer.applyPreset(new File('C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Behaviors/Rotate Over Time.ffx')), then set effect('Rotate Over Time')('Rotation (degrees/second)'). The property is an Angle (degrees) with no harvested min/max. The preset adds a Transform effect whose Rotation expression is (time - inPoint) * rate, so the spin starts at the layer in-point and turns around the layer centre (for text/shape layers the Transform anchor/position are set to toComp(anchorPoint)). For fast spins give that Transform effect its own motion blur: uncheck 'Use Composition's Shutter Angle' and set 'Shutter Angle' to about 180. Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.

cards.name: Sample Image
cards.summary: Control for the preset 'Image - Utilities/Sample Image Expression': its Sampled Color Output colour is driven by sampleImage(Center, [Radius, Radius]) on the layer, so it continuously reads the average colour of an area of the image. It changes no pixels; other properties link to the sampled colour.
use_for: auto-tint a lower-third bar or caption box to the dominant colour of the shot behind it
drive a light, glow or vignette colour from the footage so graphics sit in the grade
read whether an area is bright or dark to switch caption text black/white in a reel template
avoid: default Radius 0.5 samples a single pixel and flickers with noise; use 20-100
sampleImage expressions are slow to render and slow previews on long timelines
colour jumps at every cut unless smoothed (e.g. smooth() or a short ease)

params.name: Center
params.does: pixel point whose surrounding area is sampled
params.typical: [960, 540] or the area under the graphic, e.g. [960, 900]

params.name: Radius
params.does: half-size of the square sample area in pixels

params.name: Sampled Color Output
params.does: result colour (expression-driven); pick-whip other colour properties to it

cards.scripting: Apply with layer.applyPreset(new File('C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Image - Utilities/Sample Image Expression.ffx')); the preset expression is center=effect('Sample Image')(1); radius=effect('Sample Image')(2); sampleImage(center,[radius,radius]), which samples the layer it sits on. To sample a different layer, rewrite it as thisComp.layer('X').sampleImage(...). Downstream colours read it via effect('Sample Image')('Sampled Color Output'), which returns a 0-1 RGBA array. Do not set Sampled Color Output from a spec, because the expression overwrites it. Center is in layer pixels. Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.

cards.name: Scale Bounce - layer markers
cards.summary: Control for the Behaviors preset 'Scale Bounce - layer markers': at every layer marker the layer swells to the target scale and eases back to 100%, a pop that peaks exactly on the marker. On its own the control does nothing.
use_for: pop a logo, icon or stat card on music beats marked as layer markers in a reel
punch a keyword caption on the VO emphasis word
hit a 'BREAKING' or 'FACT CHECK' badge on each sting in a news package
avoid: default Target Scale Change 200 doubles the size: far too big for anything but a gag
no layer markers = no motion (the expression's catch returns 100)
the swell is symmetric around the marker (it starts Bounce Duration/2 before it), so put markers exactly on the beat frame, not early

params.name: Bounce Duration (msec)
params.does: total length of each pop in ms, centred on the marker (half before, half after)

params.name: Target Scale Change
params.does: peak scale (%) reached exactly at the marker

cards.equivalent: Premiere: keyframe Motion > Scale per beat (no marker-driven effect)
cards.scripting: Apply with layer.applyPreset(new File('C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Behaviors/Scale Bounce - layer markers.ffx')). It needs LAYER markers (not comp markers): layer.property('Marker').setValueAtTime(t, new MarkerValue('')). Preset expression on the Transform effect's Scale: bounceWidth = msec/2000; easeIn(Math.abs(time - marker.nearestKey(time).time), bounceWidth, 0, target, 100), wrapped in try/catch returning 100. AE sorts the reversed tMin/tMax range, so distance 0 (on the marker) gives Target and the layer is back at 100% once it is bounceWidth away. It runs on a Transform effect, and for text/shape layers the Transform anchor is set to toComp(anchorPoint). Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.

cards.name: Scale Bounce - random
cards.summary: Control for the Behaviors preset 'Scale Bounce - random': noise over time randomly pushes the layer's scale from 100% toward the target scale, giving irregular nervous pops. On its own the control does nothing.
use_for: irregular pulse on an alert or warning icon in a news reel
nervous 'buzzing' map pins or data points in an explainer
random pops on meme stickers or emoji in a satire reel
avoid: default Target Scale Change 200 is huge; use 110-130 for usable pops
not beat-synced: use the layer-markers version when music timing matters
high Bounce Nervousness on text makes it unreadable

params.name: Chance of Bouncing
params.does: how often noise crosses the bounce threshold (0 = never, 100 = most of the time)

params.name: Bounce Nervousness
params.does: speed of the underlying noise (higher = quicker, twitchier pops)

params.name: Target Scale Change
params.does: scale (%) reached at full bounce

cards.equivalent: Premiere: no equivalent (keyframe Motion > Scale by hand)
cards.scripting: Apply with layer.applyPreset(new File('C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Behaviors/Scale Bounce - random.ffx')). Preset expression on the Transform effect's Scale: compare=(50-Chance)/50; n=noise(time*Nervousness/20); linear(n, compare, 1, 100, Target). noise() depends only on its input (comp time here), not on the layer or seedRandom, so every layer carrying this preset bounces in exact sync; to desynchronise copies edit the expression to noise(time*Nervousness/20 + index*10). Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.

cards.name: Separate XYZ Position
cards.summary: Legacy control from the preset 'Legacy/Separate XYZ Position': three sliders whose values are ADDED to the layer's Position by an expression, so X, Y and Z could be keyframed independently. It is superseded by the native Separate Dimensions on Position.
use_for: only for opening old projects that already use it
an independent X/Y offset layered on top of existing position keyframes (e.g. a slide added over tracked motion)
avoid: for new work use Position > Separate Dimensions instead
the values are offsets, not absolute positions: 0 means 'no change'
applying the bare effect by match name does nothing: only the preset's Position expression reads the sliders, so apply Legacy/Separate XYZ Position.ffx

params.name: X Position
params.does: pixels added to the layer's X position

params.name: Y Position
params.does: pixels added to the layer's Y position

params.name: Z Position
params.does: pixels added to Z (3D layers only)

cards.equivalent: Premiere: Motion > Position (AE native replacement: Position > Separate Dimensions)
cards.scripting: Preset file: Support Files/Presets/Legacy/Separate XYZ Position.ffx; expression: value + [X Position, Y Position, Z Position]. Modern replacement: layer.transform.position.dimensionsSeparated = true, then keyframe layer.transform.xPosition / yPosition / zPosition. Hidden: not in the Effects panel. The .ffx also stores a static layer Position of [320, 240, 0] (an old 640x480 default) next to the expression, so read transform.position before applyPreset and write it back afterwards in case the preset resets it.

verified.note: Frame is pixel-identical to the untouched render (zero difference to 051.png): the gallery adds the bare effect with X/Y/Z 0 and no Position expression, so no demo_settings value can move the layer; the card is already obsolete, so status stays obsolete rather than needs_input.
verified.second_opinion: corrected: verdict broken, status obsolete and the new avoid line confirmed (267 is pixel-identical to 8 other no-op frames incl. 051 and keeps the ref framing; the Legacy .ffx carries the value + [X,Y,Z] Position expression, the bare effect has none, so no demo_settings can help); added a scripting note that the .ffx also stores layer Position [320, 240, 0], so restore Position after applyPreset

previous.why: the harness lacked the setup it needs (see note)

cards.name: Separate XYZ Scale
cards.summary: Control for the Behaviors preset 'Separate XYZ Scale': three sliders are added to the layer's Scale through an expression ([X, Y, Z] + value), so X, Y and Z scale offsets can be keyframed separately with different eases. AE still cannot natively separate Scale dimensions.
use_for: squash-and-stretch pops on icons or stickers in reels
horizontal-only stretch reveal of a lower-third bar or title underline
vertical bar-grow animation in a data explainer with its own easing per axis
avoid: the sliders are OFFSETS added to the layer's own Scale ([X,Y,Z] + value): the preset applies them at 0 with the layer at 100%, so 0 = no change and X Scale -100 = zero width; adding the bare effect by match name gives the PresetEffects default 100 but no expression, so nothing moves
non-uniform scale distorts faces and footage badly

params.name: X Scale
params.does: percent added to the layer's horizontal scale (0 = no change)

params.name: Y Scale
params.does: percent added to the layer's vertical scale (0 = no change)

params.name: Z Scale
params.does: percent added to depth scale (3D layers only)

cards.equivalent: Premiere: Motion > Scale Height / Scale Width with Uniform Scale off
cards.scripting: Preset file: Support Files/Presets/Behaviors/Separate XYZ Scale.ffx; expression on the layer's Scale: [X Scale, Y Scale, Z Scale] + value. The .ffx stores the three sliders at 0 and the layer Scale at 100%, so right after applyPreset the layer is unchanged and the sliders work as offsets (slider UI range -100 to 100); applying may reset a fitted layer's Scale to 100%, so read transform.scale before and write it back. To make the sliders absolute instead, set transform.scale to [0,0,0] (2D: [0,0]) and the sliders to 100. Simpler alternative for scripts: keyframe transform.scale directly with a different value per axis ([x, y]). Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.
verified.second_opinion: corrected: not_rendered agreed (no gallery frame), but the '200% with default sliders' claim was wrong: the .ffx stores X/Y/Z Scale at 0 and layer Scale 100% (cdat values; PresetEffects slider range -100..100), so the preset leaves the layer at 100% and the sliders are offsets; summary, avoid, params and scripting rewritten as offsets

cards.name: Slide - variable
cards.summary: Orphaned transition control: a Transition Completion slider with an Entrance Angle and Initial Scale, meant to slide a layer in from an angle while scaling up. No preset shipped with AE 2026 references it, so it does nothing unless a script writes the expressions.
use_for: angled slide-and-grow entrance of a photo or inset card in an explainer (with custom expressions)
a control to drive a self-written slide-in rig from one keyframed slider
avoid: adding it alone does nothing; prefer the shipped 'Slide - straight / drop / swoop' presets (Slide Master Control)

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: 0 = off-screen start, 100 = settled (%)

params.name: Entrance Angle
params.does: direction (degrees) the layer travels in from

params.name: Initial Scale
params.does: scale (%) at the start of the slide

cards.equivalent: Premiere: Slide (Legacy) or Push video transition (closest; no angle or scale control)
cards.scripting: Low confidence: definition only in PresetEffects.xml; a grep of every .ffx under Support Files/Presets found no preset using it. The Entrance Angle mapping (0 = from top or from right?) is unknown, so a script must write and test its own Position/Scale expressions, e.g. p=effect('Slide - variable')('Transition Completion'); a=degreesToRadians(effect('Slide - variable')('Entrance Angle')); d=linear(p,0,100,2200,0); value + [Math.sin(a)*d, -Math.cos(a)*d]. Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.

cards.name: Slide Master Control
cards.summary: Master control for the 'Transitions - Movement' presets Slide - straight, Slide - drop and Slide - swoop: keyframing Transition Completion from 0 to 100 moves the layer into its resting position. Straight slides in horizontally by one layer width, drop slides in vertically by one layer height, swoop arcs in from a top corner while scaling up from 0%.
use_for: slide a B-roll photo or document scan into frame in a news package
slide a full-frame section card in or out between explainer chapters
slide a picture-in-picture inset in from the side (reverse direction for the other side)
avoid: without motion blur the slide looks stiff; enable motion blur or add Directional Blur
linear keyframes feel robotic; use Easy Ease on Transition Completion
the bare effect by match name does nothing; the preset's Transform expressions do the moving
the offset is one layer width/height from where the layer sits, so a small inset placed mid-frame starts partly on screen; use a full-frame precomp or add your own position offset

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: 0 = offset by one layer width (straight) / height (drop), or at the top corner at 0% scale (swoop); 100 = in place (%)
params.typical: keyframe 0 -> 100 over 0.4-0.8 s (reverse for an exit)

params.name: reverse direction
params.does: checkbox (0/1): straight 0 = from the left, 1 = from the right; drop 0 = from the top, 1 = from the bottom; swoop 0 = from the top-left, 1 = from the top-right

cards.equivalent: Premiere: Push or Slide (Legacy) video transition
cards.scripting: Apply a preset that carries it, e.g. layer.applyPreset(new File('C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Transitions - Movement/Slide - straight.ffx')) (also 'Slide - drop.ffx', 'Slide - swoop.ffx'), then keyframe effect('Slide Master Control')('Transition Completion'). Each preset adds a Transform effect: straight sets its Position to [linear(c,0,100,-thisLayer.width,0), 0] (+width when reverse direction is 1); drop does the same on Y with thisLayer.height; swoop sets Anchor to the layer centre, Position along a sine arc from [0 or width, 0] to the centre, and Scale linear(c,0,100,0,100). The property name 'reverse direction' is lowercase. Delete any keyframes the preset already set before writing your own. Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.

cards.name: Stereo 3D Controls
cards.summary: The control effect AE puts on the 'Stereo 3D Controls' layer when you run Layer > Camera > Create Stereo 3D Rig: it sets the left/right camera separation (scene depth) and convergence of a stereoscopic camera pair. It changes no pixels and needs a 3D camera rig.
use_for: retro red-cyan anaglyph 3D gimmick on a trailer or reel title (with the 3D Glasses effect)
stereo left/right renders of a 3D-layer graphics scene for VR or 3D-TV delivery
avoid: it is only meaningful inside a stereo rig created by AE; adding it to a layer by hand does nothing
the rig renders the scene twice, so heavy comps double in render time
anaglyph red-cyan looks dated and ruins skin tones on live action

params.name: Configuration
params.does: how the left/right cameras are placed: Center = both offset equally from the master camera; Hero Left / Hero Right = that eye stays on the master camera and only the other moves

params.name: Stereo Scene Depth
params.does: interaxial separation as % of comp width (strength of the 3D)

params.name: Converge Cameras
params.does: checkbox (0/1): toe the cameras in to a convergence point

params.name: Converge To
params.does: what sets the convergence plane (zero parallax)

params.name: Convergence Z Offset
params.does: moves the zero-parallax plane forward/back in pixels

cards.scripting: Needs a camera: build the rig in AE (Layer > Camera > Create Stereo 3D Rig; scripted via app.executeCommand(app.findMenuCommandId('Create Stereo 3D Rig')) with the comp active and its camera selected; command ID not harvested and untested from script). The rig adds a layer carrying this effect plus left/right-eye comps and a 3D Glasses output. Popup labels come from Support Files/PresetEffects.xml: Configuration = Center|Hero Left|Hero Right; Converge To = Camera Position|Camera Point of Interest|Zoom Distance. The group headers (Camera Separation, Convergence Options) are not addressable; set leaf names. Stereo Scene Depth is shown as a percent. Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.

cards.name: Stretch Master Control
cards.summary: Master control for the 'Transitions - Movement' presets Stretch & Slide, Stretch & Blur and Stretch Over - horizontal / vertical: keyframing Transition Completion from 0 to 100 snaps the layer from a stretched state to normal size. Stretch & Slide: width 2000% -> 100% while sliding in from the left and fading in over the first third; Stretch & Blur: width 500% / height 125% -> 100% as a Fast Box Blur clears and it eases in; Stretch Over: one axis grows from 0% while the other settles from 150% to 100%.
use_for: punchy stretch-in of a photo or headline card in a fast reel
snap a title into place at the start of a trailer beat
stretch transition between sections of a political explainer
avoid: on faces the extreme stretch frames look grotesque; keep it short (0.3-0.5 s)
slow stretch transitions read as cheap 2000s PowerPoint
the bare effect by match name does nothing; apply one of the Stretch presets

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: 0 = fully stretched (transparent, or 0% wide/high for Stretch Over), 100 = normal layer (%)

cards.equivalent: Premiere: Stretch In / Stretch Over video transitions (legacy set), or Stretch Wipe (GPU)
cards.scripting: Apply e.g. layer.applyPreset(new File('C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Transitions - Movement/Stretch & Slide.ffx')) (also 'Stretch & Blur.ffx', 'Stretch Over - horizontal.ffx', 'Stretch Over - vertical.ffx'), then keyframe effect('Stretch Master Control')('Transition Completion'). All four drive a Transform effect: Stretch & Slide = Anchor linear(c,0,100,[w,h/2],[w/2,h/2]), Scale Width linear(c,0,100,2000,100), Opacity linear(c,0,33,0,100); Stretch & Blur = Fast Box Blur radius linear(c,0,100,w/10,0), Scale Height 125 -> 100, Scale Width 500 -> 100, Opacity easeOut 0 -> 100; Stretch Over horizontal = Scale Width = c (0 -> 100), Scale Height easeOut 150 -> 100; vertical = Scale Height easeOut 0 -> 100, Scale Width easeOut 150 -> 100. 'Stretch - Edge.ffx' uses a different control (Stretch Master Control (edge)). Hidden: not in the Effects panel.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (expression/preset control that draws nothing on its own), so the AE gallery rendered no frame for it.
